# AIBfamily — safe AI for kids (in development)
> AIBfamily is in development. It is being built on AIB.core, the engine behind AIBEVA, and is made for families. It is not available for purchase yet.

## Key facts
- Status: in development, not yet available
- For: children aged 4–15, with a parent dashboard
- Designed for: COPPA, UK Children's Code, GDPR Article 8, EU AI Act
- No child accounts by design
- Built by SAY TO PAY s.r.o. (AIBlab), Ostrava, Czech Republic, EU
- Available now from the same company: AIBEVA, a personal AI assistant for Windows — https://aibeva.com
- Contact: info@aiblab.info
